sentences.text: For this home loan, the RBI pre-payment rule that applies permits a prepayment charge for this case, because the bank is a Tier 3 UCB and the loan was sanctioned on 10 February 2026. (R2)
I cannot say whether clause 9.3 is compliant because the clause 9.3 wording was not provided in the evidence, and no evidence item states what that clause says. (E1,E2,E3,E4,E5,E6)
